title: Protected reference outline: A03 Configure logical volumes
answer: A suitable solution for Configure logical volumes should satisfy this objective: Create and extend test logical volumes only inside a disposable virtual environment with a snapshot. Work in a disposable lab; record the exact commands/tool versions, expected and observed output/status, a boundary case, and recovery steps. Before state-changing actions, preview the target and make a recoverable backup. This reference outline is not a substitute for validating distribution-specific commands on the intended system.
explanation: Review execution evidence and reasoning rather than requiring one exact command sequence. Missing tools, permission boundaries, host policy, and distribution versions should be reported accurately.
